title: [Bug] `top_k_top_p_sampling_from_probs` segfaults (host-side) during vLLM sampler warm-up on MI300X (gfx942), aiter main @ e8f438a
body:
### Problem description

Serving a large model through vLLM on 8×MI300X with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, the engine segfaults during **sampler warm-up** (before serving the first request), inside aiter's compiled `top_k_top_p_sampling_from_probs`:

```
!!!!!!! Segfault encountered !!!!!!!
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in top_k_top_p_sampling_from_probs_51f5779b2644c0a61347d39ea3295db7
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in _PyObject_MakeTpCall
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in _PyEval_EvalFrameDefault
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in pybind11::object pybind11::detail::object_api<...>::operator()<...>
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in torch::impl::dispatch::PythonKernelHolder::operator()(...)
  File "<unknown>", line 0, in c10::Dispatcher::callBoxed(...)
```

- Repeats on multiple TP workers (observed 7×), **host-side** segfault — `dmesg` is clean, no GPU fault, no amdgpu errors.
- Deterministic: killed the launch at sampler warm-up every time (reproduced across container restarts on the same build).

### Environment

- aiter: main @ `e8f438a748d27d5350b9a2d63c8e1cffc2626f52` (2026-08-17), built from source per the vLLM `Dockerfile.rocm` flow
- Base image: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:kimi-k3` (vLLM `0.1.dev19253+g5f76ae224.d20260727`)
- torch 2.11.0+gitd0c8b1f / ROCm 7.2.53211 / Python 3.12.13 / Ubuntu 22.04.5
- 8× MI300X (gfx942), TP=8; model: Kimi-K3 (KimiLinear hybrid), but the sampler path is model-independent

### Notes / suspicions

- The sampler op is **not arch-gated** (unlike the MoE/MLA paths), so this is likely tip-of-main churn rather than a gfx942 gap — but we could only test on gfx942.
- Workaround we're shipping: force vLLM's `forward_native` sampler in `vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py`. Native sampler cost is negligible at our batch sizes; everything else (aiter MoE etc.) stays on aiter.
- A secondary DX note for whoever owns the vLLM integration: the aiter sampler rides the master `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` switch with no dedicated env gate, so when the sampler op breaks, the only recourse is patching vLLM source — a `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_SAMPLER=0` style gate would have made this a one-line mitigation. Happy to file that separately on vllm-project if preferred.

### Repro

Any vLLM launch on this build with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` reaching sampler warm-up. Full launch log (19k lines, including all 7 segfault traces interleaved with NCCL init) excerpt (segfault traces + surrounding init, secret gist): https://gist.github.com/skimanwhite/12834cbe92fff32634735786f2b9b178
